# Run 1 (world: The Free Cities)
Session open. Chapter 2. Approval: autopilot. Spoilers: off.

## Changed since last session
Nothing changed since the last session.

## Settings
- as of: Spring, year 300
- genre: low fantasy
- tone: grim
- difficulty: balanced
- length: standard
- pacing: balanced
- dice: GM rolls
- turn_length: standard
- lines: harm to children
- veils: sexual content

## Voice anchor
Interior level: deep
Clipped, close third person, past tense. Plain diction, hard edges, dry humor; violence quick and ugly.

Sample:
> Rain came off the Black Wall in sheets, and the squire counted coins he didn't have.

## Open threads

- Who is selling the company?: The Triarch seems to know the company's plans.

## Chapters

### Places

- [Dragon's Den](places/dragons-den.md): A district of eastern Volantis.
- [Long Bridge](places/long-bridge.md): The bridge joining the two halves of Volantis. Closed by the Triarch's order: crossing needs a stamped pass.

### Factions

- [Golden Company](factions/golden-company.md): The largest sellsword company in Essos, camped outside Volantis. It owes Triarch Malaquo two months of grain bought on credit.

- [Lissa](characters/lissa.md): A ferry-girl on the Rhoyne. Her mother lives in the Dragon's Den district.
- [Lysono Qhoran](characters/lysono-qhoran.md): The Golden Company's paymaster. Watches the captains' books and their loyalties.

- [Triarch Malaquo](characters/triarch-malaquo.md): One of the three Triarchs of Volantis.

- [Lissa's letter](items/lissas-letter.md): A letter Lissa gave Marro to carry to her mother in the Dragon's Den.
- [Old whetstone](items/old-whetstone.md): Rickard's old whetstone, given to Marro. Marro carries it.

input.summary: Chapter 2 opens in the camp below the Black Wall, four days before Pallo's debt falls due. Hesse sends Marro to Rickard, mentioning the captain closed his strongbox fast last night. Hesse saw Rickard close his strongbox fast when she came into his tent the night before chapter 2, and told Marro.

input.summary: Night watch on the camp's eastern edge. Marro shares his waterskin with Hesse, who asks whether he'll take Rickard's errand and hints she remembers he knows Volantis's streets. A slave caravan passes below, bound for the Long Bridge; Marro watches in silence and Hesse stands close. Rickard comes up the slope, reminisces about Brother Olyvar, and presses Marro for an answer on the errand; Hesse keeps the talk on her lame horse.

updates.body: The farrier says Ash's hoof has gone soft; Hesse expects the horse won't last to summer.

Slavers' caravans are granted passes across the Long Bridge despite the Triarch's closure. A caravan of about twenty chained slaves, with two mounted guards, passed the camp at night heading for the Bridge.
Guards at Volantis's eastern gates check faces and hands for slave tattoos. Volantene slaves are tattooed on the cheek (one seen in the caravan bore three green tears).
On night watch Rickard pressed Marro again for an answer on the city errand. Marro has still not answered.

thread_changes.body: Rickard asked again on the night watch; answer still pending.
